android.desc: ✨ "It is our choices, Harry, that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities" - Albus Dumbledore ✨ ⚠️ iChooseTo may not work on devices that are very restrictive with background processes (e.g. Samsung, OnePlus, Huawei, Xiaomi). Please visit dontkillmyapp.com to eventually make it work! ⚠️ 🔥 Main functionalities: 🛑 iCT: Before you open an app (of choice), a screen appears (for a chosen amount of time), asking you if you really want to open it. ⏳ re-iCT: Choose again after a certain amount of time. 🔐 iCT-on-unlock: Stop unconsciously checking your phone! iCT-on-unlock will show up each time you attempt to unlock your phone and ask you if you really want to do it. 📱 Do you find yourself wasting hours on semi-productive apps like YouTube, Instagram, Reddit, or WhatsApp? 🤯 Have you tried every PlayStore app that promises to boost your productivity, but you still have the bad habit of opening time-wasting apps without a second thought? 💡 Why is iChooseTo different? ✅ 1) It gives YOU the power to choose: You can use apps for both productive and unproductive things. So why block them completely? iCT asks you if you really want to open the app and forces you to make conscious decisions. ⏳ 2) It stops you BEFORE you already wasted time: Many app blockers stop you after you've run out of time ⏱️. They limit the time you're able to waste. iCT makes it less likely that you'll waste time in the first place! 🚀 Give it a try, write a review with ideas for improvement, and be part of making this the best app-blocking app for Android! 💙

quotes.text: For this use case, I use "IChooseTo" https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appsofuse.ict
quotes.story_title: Show HN: App that asks ‘why?’ every time you unlock your phone
